_note: Index of every content module this app ships. To add a book or a new scripture translation/language: drop a new file under content/scripture/<translation_id>/<book_id>.json (see tools/import_scripture.py) and add one entry to "scripture" here. To add or extend a UI-language translation of the topics content (feeling label/description, entry reflection/prayer -- NOT scripture text): drop a content/topics/<language>.json file and add one entry to "topic_translations" here; any topic or entry missing from that file just falls back to English. Either way, no need to touch core.json, topics.json, or any other module. Bump content_version whenever any module changes so SeedLoader re-seeds on next launch.
